sn54.8:1.1: ānāpānassatisamādhi bhikkhave bhāvito bahulīkato mahapphalo hoti mahānisaṃso.
sn54.8:1.2: kathaṃ bhāvito ca bhikkhave ānāpānassatisamādhi kathaṃ bahulīkato mahapphalo hoti mahānisaṃso.
sn54.8:2.1: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā nisīdati pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
sn54.8:2.3: dīghaṃ vā assasanto dīghaṃ assasāmīti pajānāti (vitthāretabbā yāva
sn54.8:2.4: paṭinissaggānupassī assasissāmīti sikkhati paṭinissaggānupassī passasissāmīti sikkhati).
sn54.8:2.5: evaṃ bhāvito kho bhikkhave ānāpānassatisamādhi evaṃ bahulīkato mahapphalo hoti mahānisaṃso.
sn54.8:3.1: ahampi sudaṃ bhikkhave pubbeva sambodhā anabhisambuddho bodhisattova samāno iminā vihārena bahulaṃ viharāmi.
sn54.8:3.2: tassa mayhaṃ bhikkhave iminā vihārena bahulaṃ viharato neva kāyo kilamati na cakkhūni
sn54.8:3.3: anupādāya ca me āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccati.
sn54.8:4.1: tasmā tiha bhikkhave bhikkhu cepi ākaṅkheyya
sn54.8:4.2: neva me kāyopi kilameyya na cakkhūni anupādāya ca me āsavehi cittaṃ vimucceyyāti
sn54.8:5.1: tasmā tiha bhikkhave bhikkhu cepi ākaṅkheyya
sn54.8:5.2: ye me gehasitā sarasaṅkappā te pahīyeyyunti
sn54.8:6.1: tasmā tiha bhikkhave bhikkhu cepi ākaṅkheyya
sn54.8:7.1: tasmā tiha bhikkhave bhikkhu cepi ākaṅkheyya
sn54.8:8.1: tasmā tiha bhikkhave bhikkhu cepi ākaṅkheyya appaṭikūle ca
sn54.8:9.1: tasmā tiha bhikkhave bhikkhu cepi ākaṅkheyya
sn54.8:9.2: paṭikūle ca appaṭikūle ca appaṭikūlasaññī vihareyyanti
sn54.8:10.1: tasmā tiha bhikkhave bhikkhu cepi ākaṅkheyya
sn54.8:10.2: appaṭikūlañca paṭikūlañca tadubhayaṃ abhinivajjetvā upekkhako vihareyyaṃ sato sampajānoti
sn54.8:11.1: tasmā tiha bhikkhave bhikkhu cepi ākaṅkheyya
sn54.8:11.2: vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja vihareyyanti
sn54.8:12.1: tasmā tiha bhikkhave bhikkhu cepi ākaṅkheyya
sn54.8:12.2: vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja vihareyyanti
sn54.8:13.1: tasmā tiha bhikkhave bhikkhu cepi ākaṅkheyya
sn54.8:13.2: pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca vihareyyaṃ sato ca sampajāno sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeyyaṃ yantaṃ ariyā ācikkhanti upekkhako satimā sukhavihārīti tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja vihareyyanti
sn54.8:14.1: tasmā tiha bhikkhave bhikkhu cepi ākaṅkheyya
sn54.8:14.2: sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja vihareyyanti
sn54.8:15.1: tasmā tiha bhikkhave bhikkhu cepi ākaṅkheyya
sn54.8:15.2: sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅgamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā ananto ākāsoti ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja vihareyyanti
sn54.8:16.1: tasmā tiha bhikkhave bhikkhu cepi ākaṅkheyya
sn54.8:16.2: sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma anantaṃ viññāṇanti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja vihareyyanti
sn54.8:17.1: tasmā tiha bhikkhave bhikkhu cepi ākaṅkheyya
sn54.8:17.2: sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma natthi kiñcīti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja vihareyyanti
sn54.8:18.1: tasmā tiha bhikkhave bhikkhu cepi ākaṅkheyya
sn54.8:18.2: sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja vihareyyanti
sn54.8:19.1: tasmā tiha bhikkhave bhikkhu cepi ākaṅkheyya
sn54.8:19.2: sabbaso nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ upasampajja vihareyyanti
sn54.8:20.1: evaṃ bhāvite kho bhikkhave ānāpānassatisamādhimhi evaṃ bahulīkate sukhañce vedanaṃ vedayati sā aniccāti pajānāti anajjhositāti pajānāti anabhinanditāti pajānāti.
sn54.8:20.2: dukkhañce vedanaṃ vedayati sā aniccāti pajānāti anajjhositāti pajānāti anabhinanditāti pajānāti.
sn54.8:20.3: adukkhamasukhañce vedanaṃ vedayati sā aniccāti pajānāti anajjhositāti pajānāti anabhinanditāti pajānāti.
sn54.8:21.1: so sukhaṃ ce vedanaṃ vedayati visaṃyutto naṃ vedayati.
sn54.8:21.2: dukkhaṃ ce vedanaṃ vedayati visaṃyutto naṃ vedayati.
sn54.8:21.3: adukkhamasukhaṃ ce vedanaṃ vedayati visaṃyutto naṃ vedayati.
sn54.8:21.4: so kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayamāno kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayāmīti pajānāti jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayamāno jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayāmīti pajānāti
sn54.8:21.5: kāyassa bhedā uddhaṃ jīvitapariyādānā idheva sabbavedayitāni anabhinanditāni sītībhavissantīti pajānāti.
sn54.8:22.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave telañca paṭicca vaṭṭiñca paṭicca telappadīpo jhāyeyya
sn54.8:22.2: tasseva telassa ca vaṭṭiyā ca pariyādānā anāhāro nibbāyeyya.
sn54.8:22.3: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayamāno kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayāmīti pajānāti jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayamāno jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayāmīti pajānāti
sn54.8:22.4: kāyassa bhedā uddhaṃ jīvitapariyādānā idheva sabbavedayitāni anabhinanditāni sītībhavissantīti pajānātīti.
